name: Elegant Casting

components.pose: She stands tall in a poised, asymmetrical stance, one hand raised with fingers fanned to scatter a storm of ice shards, the other sweeping low to freeze a spiral of frost across the ground, shoulders squared, a cold, imperious gaze to the camera. A biting wind streams her train, sleeves and hair. Casting with her bare hands only.
components.effects: Glittering ice shards and spirals of {{MAGIC}} frost-light burst from her hands, frost creeping across the ground.

notes: Elegant casting: unique gown that fits her magic, hands-only complex casting stance with wind.
